Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ORIGINAL six-character model sheet for a cozy Korean medieval village comedy game. Create ONE wide landscape 3:2 image, six full-body characters standing side by side on the same ground line, all clearly separated, no overlaps, all feet and hairstyles visible. Plain warm ivory background, no scenery, no frame, NO LETTERS, NO LABELS, no speech bubbles, no logos. The two supplied building pictures are STYLE references only: match their warm hand-painted storybook rendering, softly textured brushwork, grounded rustic detail, warm light, clear silhouettes. NOT pixel art, NOT anime, NOT flat vector, NOT glossy 3D. Gentle observational comedy, original faces, no existing fictional characters.
LEFT TO RIGHT, exactly SIX figures:
1. Newly appointed village chief, about 25, slim average height, short chestnut-brown CURLY hair, freshly made moss-green vest over loose ivory-white linen shirt, tan trousers, simple brown boots, baffled innocent expression. No beard or hat.
2. Marta, SHORT ROUND elderly grandmother, silver-white hair in a tidy round bun, kind round face and only a faint amber-orange glint in her eyes, cream blouse, muted plum skirt, pale cream apron patterned with small orange and pink flowers, sensible brown shoes. Hands gently folded. No wizard costume.
3. Gunter, TALL THIN middle-aged man, long shaggy gray bangs completely covering his eyes, thin long face, worn brown leather vest over dusty beige shirt, dark practical trousers, plain woodcutter axe on his back. Reserved posture. No armor or sword.
4. Bruno, HUGE broad middle-aged man, gentle friendly face, short brown hair and SHORT BROWN BEARD, taut faded blue-gray work overalls over beige shirt, old heavy brown belt with a worn brass knight-order medallion, large hands. No armor.
5. Pino, slim merchant around 30, BLACK CURLY hair, lively narrow face, LONG FOREST-GREEN SCARF, ocher-brown traveling coat, laden large backpack with pots, ropes and small bundles hanging from it. Charming innocent smile.
6. Barg, bulky intimidating middle-aged tavern keeper, dark burgundy headscarf, broad stern face, dark rolled-sleeve shirt and worn tan apron. Two very subtle horn-shaped bumps underneath his headscarf, no visible giant demon horns. Sturdy boots.
Make distinct stable faces and outfit silhouettes suitable for reuse in 10 story scenes. Express personalities with natural poses, not cartoon motion lines. Keep the entire lineup large within the page and preserve realistic relative heights.
